title: Registry discovery document
description: The registry.json document at a root, and what an origin root serves at /.well-known/registry.json. Tells a client the storage format, what the root offers, how to authenticate, and where blobs and kind manifests live. File spec section 3.1.

kind.description: Distinguishes this from a host document. Absent means registry.

slug.description: Owner slug: the org-level workspace slug on a hosted root, the repository owner on a repository root. Never appears in a path.

url.description: The canonical root. SHOULD be present on an HTTPS root; a directory has no fixed address and omits it. A client records it as the registry's identity and MUST NOT follow it as a redirect.

capabilities.description: What this root offers. A file root advertises files. Other values are reserved for a future server.

blob_url.description: URI template for content-addressed blobs. MUST contain the literal {digest}, which expands to the bare 64-hex digest without the sha256: prefix. A relative template resolves against the root. Default: blobs/sha256/{digest}.

kinds.description: Kinds this root holds and where their manifests live.

manifest_url.description: Where the kind manifest lives: a JSON Schema for spec plus the x-registry-* keywords. A relative reference resolves against the root, so a root may serve its own manifests.

api_version.description: Kept for a future server. A format 1 file root omits it.
